title: Roamhaven Rewards Credits on Refunded Stays: Tier Terms
content:
Roamhaven Rewards treats a refunded stay in two ways, according to how the credits relate to the stay: credits **redeemed** on the stay are reinstated in the proportion of the stay amount refunded, and credits **earned** on the stay are taken back when the stay is later refunded. The terms are identical on every tier.

| Tier | Redeemed credits when the stay is refunded | Fewest calendar days a reinstated credit stays valid | Earned credits taken back when the stay is later refunded |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rewards Member | Reinstated in the proportion of the stay amount refunded | 90 | Yes |
| Rewards Silver | Reinstated in the proportion of the stay amount refunded | 90 | Yes |
| Rewards Gold | Reinstated in the proportion of the stay amount refunded | 90 | Yes |
| Rewards Platinum | Reinstated in the proportion of the stay amount refunded | 90 | Yes |
| Rewards Diamond | Reinstated in the proportion of the stay amount refunded | 90 | Yes |
| Rewards Ambassador | Reinstated in the proportion of the stay amount refunded | 90 | Yes |

## Basis questions and answers

**What is the tier term for credits redeemed on a stay that is refunded?**
On every tier, redeemed credits are reinstated in the proportion of the stay amount refunded: the larger the share of the stay amount refunded, the larger the share of the redeemed credits reinstated.

**How long does a reinstated credit last?**
At least 90 calendar days; that is the fewest days a reinstated credit stays valid on every tier.

**What is the tier term for credits earned on a stay that is later refunded?**
On every tier the term is set to yes: credits earned on a stay are taken back when the stay is later refunded.

**Does the member's tier change these terms?**
No. All six tiers, from Rewards Member to Rewards Ambassador, carry the same three terms.
